description: Intent i002 (snapshot s01, branch xsk-umem-rereads) complete. FINDING: include/net/xdp_sock.h:162-182, xsk_tx_metadata_request() — the AF_XDP TX metadata area is UMEM userspace-shared memory (meta = data - pool->tx_metadata_len, include/net/xdp_sock_drv.h:276); its only validation is the single flags fetch in __xsk_buff_get_metadata()/xsk_buff_valid_tx_metadata() (xdp_sock_drv.h:262-281), which returns the raw shared pointer rather than a snapshot. xsk_tx_metadata_request() then independently re-reads meta->flags (lines 170/175/179), meta->request.launch_time (171), and meta->request.csum_start/csum_offset (180-181) with no READ_ONCE-into-local, so the validated copy and the consumed copy can diverge under a racing userspace writer in ZC driver TX paths (igc_main.c:3077, stmmac_main.c:2735, mlx5 en/xsk/tx.c:102, libeth xsk.h:208). Confidence medium: current in-tree tmo_request_checksum implementations (mlx5e_xsk_request_checksum, libeth_xsktmo_req_csum) ignore the fetched offsets and only set descriptor bits, so no concrete OOB is demonstrated on this path; also noted xsk_tx_metadata_to_compl()/xsk_destruct_skb() snapshot a write pointer into shared UMEM. NEGATIVE/SAFE evidence: TX-ring descriptors are single-fetched into a local struct xdp_desc before validation (xsk_queue.h:242,267) and fill-ring addresses into a local u64 (xsk_buff_pool.c:554,609), satisfying the invariant; net/xdp/xsk.c:774-781 is the seed's own pre-fix double read (excluded). Bounded limitations: stmmac callback bodies, gve TX function, and snapshots s02-s04 (other intents) were not fully audited. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i002.json (version 1, snapshots_checked ["s01"], 1 finding, 11 classified candidates, 5 limitations).
